content: If the XfrmDevErrorDetect switch is enabled and the configuration variant is VARIANT - POST - BUIL D, the function E2EXf_Init shall check the contents of the given configuration set for being within the allowed boundaries. If the function E2EXf_Init detects an error, then it shall skip the initialization of the E2E Transformer, keep the module in ternal state as uninitialized and it shall report development error code E2EXF_E_INIT_FAILED to the Det_ReportError service of the Default Error Tracer .
